draft_statement: Draft core: identify these leading displayed joint-curve differences: Knee GVS 3.13 degrees; Ankle GVS 3.10 degrees. Choose which joints actually deserve emphasis; ranking is not clinical severity.

draft_statement: Draft core: describe Semitendinosus (ST) as above the phase-specific reference mean at about 27% of the analysis cycle, with displayed max |z| 4.1. Decide whether it merits inclusion or replace it with a more relevant input-supported finding.

selection_basis: One of two largest displayed max-|z| values; alphabetical tie-break only selects a review candidate. No uniqueness or exact rank is required.
